page.overview:
Who is Shirahoshi?

Princess Shirahoshi, famous in the world as the , is a giant mermaid and the princess of the Ryugu Kingdom, as the youngest of King Neptune's children and the only daughter in the Neptune royal family.

Having been locked up and raised inside an impregnable tower for most of her childhood thanks to the constant threat of Vander Decken IX, Shirahoshi wishes to know more about the outside world, following the will of her late mother, Queen Otohime.

She is also the current incarnation of the Ancient Weapon Poseidon, to the knowledge of very few.

Shirahoshi was first mentioned by Pappag well before her debut, the starfish claiming he knew her and even promising to introduce the Straw Hat Pirates to her if they arrived on Fish-Man Island (which would later turn out to be a lie). She is a major ally during the Fish-Man Island Arc.
